fields.name: annotations
fields.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource annotations in the extra metadata.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint path for pod-to-service name association. Only used when aws_use_pod_association is enabled.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host
fields.description: Host to connect with when performing pod-to-service name association. Only used when aws_use_pod_association is enabled.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_client_cert_file
fields.description: Client certificate path for enabling mTLS on calls to the agent server.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_client_key_file
fields.description: Client certificate key path for enabling mTLS on calls to the agent server.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_server_ca_file
fields.description: TLS CA certificate path for communication with the agent server.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_tls_debug
fields.description: TLS debug level for agent server connection: 0 (no debug), 1 (error), 2 (state change), 3 (info), 4 (verbose).

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_tls_verify
fields.description: Enable or disable verification of TLS peer certificate for agent server connection.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_port
fields.description: Port to connect with for pod-to-service name association. Only used when aws_use_pod_association is enabled.

fields.name: aws_pod_service_map_refresh_interval
fields.description: Refresh interval in seconds for the pod-to-service map.

fields.name: aws_pod_service_map_ttl
fields.description: Time-To-Live (TTL) for pod-to-service map cache entries. Set to 0 to disable TTL and evict entries at random when capacity is reached.

fields.name: aws_pod_service_preload_cache_dir
fields.description: Directory containing pod-to-service map files for pre-loading cache.

fields.name: aws_use_pod_association
fields.description: Enable custom endpoint to get pod-to-service name mapping. Required for EKS platform detection.

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Set the buffer size for HTTP client when reading responses from Kubernetes API server. The value must conform to the unit size specification. A value of 0 results in no limit, and the buffer will expand as-needed. If pod specifications exceed the buffer limit, the API response is discarded when retrieving metadata, and some Kubernetes metadata will fail to be injected to the logs.

fields.name: cache_use_docker_id
fields.description: When enabled, metadata will be fetched from Kubernetes when docker_id is changed.

fields.name: dns_retries
fields.description: Number of DNS lookup retries until the network starts working.

fields.name: dns_wait_time
fields.description: DNS lookup interval between network status checks.

fields.name: dummy_meta
fields.description: If set, use dummy-meta data (for test/dev purposes).

fields.name: k8s-logging.exclude
fields.description: Allow Kubernetes pods to exclude their logs from the log processor.

fields.name: k8s-logging.parser
fields.description: Allow Kubernetes pods to suggest a pre-defined parser.

fields.name: keep_log
fields.description: When keep_log is disabled and merge_log enabled, the log field is removed from the incoming message once it has been successfully merged.

fields.name: kube_ca_file
fields.description: CA certificate file

fields.name: kube_ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files

fields.name: kube_meta_cache_ttl
fields.description: Configurable time-to-live for Kubernetes cached pod metadata. By default, it's set to 0 which means TTL for cache entries is disabled and cache entries are evicted at random when capacity is reached. To enable this option, set the number to a time interval. For example, set the value to 60 or 60s and cache entries which have been created more than 60 seconds ago will be evicted.

fields.name: kube_meta_namespace_cache_ttl
fields.description: Configurable time-to-live for Kubernetes cached namespace metadata. If set to 0, entries are evicted at random when capacity is reached.

fields.name: kube_meta_preload_cache_dir
fields.description: If set, Kubernetes metadata can be cached or pre-loaded from files in JSON format in this directory, named namespace-pod.meta.

fields.name: kube_tag_prefix
fields.description: When the source records come from the tail input plugin, this option specifies the prefix used in tail configuration.

fields.name: kube_token_command
fields.description: Command to get Kubernetes authorization token. Defaults to NULL uses the token file to get the token. To manually choose a command to get it, set the command here. For example, run aws-iam-authenticator -i your-cluster-name token --token-only to set token. This option is currently Linux-only.

fields.name: kube_token_file
fields.description: Token file

fields.name: kube_token_ttl
fields.description: Configurable time-to-live for the Kubernetes token. After this time, the token is reloaded from kube_token_file or the kube_token_command.

fields.name: kube_url
fields.description: API Server endpoint

fields.name: kubelet_host
fields.description: Kubelet host to use for HTTP requests. This only works when use_kubelet is set to On.

fields.name: kubelet_port
fields.description: Kubelet port to use for HTTP requests. This only works when use_kubelet is set to On.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource labels in the extra metadata.

fields.name: merge_log
fields.description: When enabled, check if the log field content is a JSON string map. If it's, append the map fields as part of the log structure.

fields.name: merge_log_key
fields.description: When merge_log is enabled, the filter assumes the log field from the incoming message is a JSON string message and attempts to create a structured representation of it at the same level of the log field in the map. If merge_log_key is set (a string name), all the new structured fields taken from the original log content are inserted under the new key.

fields.name: merge_log_trim
fields.description: When merge_log is enabled, trim (remove possible \n or \r\) field values.

fields.name: merge_parser
fields.description: Optional parser name to specify how to parse the data contained in the log key. Recommended for developers or testing only.

fields.name: namespace_annotations
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace resource annotations in the extra metadata. See Kubernetes Namespace Meta

fields.name: namespace_labels
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace resource labels in the extra metadata. See Kubernetes Namespace Meta

fields.name: namespace_metadata_only
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace metadata and no pod metadata. When set, the values of labels and annotations are ignored. See Kubernetes Namespace Meta

fields.name: owner_references
fields.description: Include Kubernetes owner references in the extra metadata.

fields.name: regex_parser
fields.description: Set an alternative Parser to process record tags and extract pod_name, namespace_name, container_name, and docker_id. The parser must be registered in a parsers file (refer to parser filter-kube-test as an example).

fields.name: set_platform
fields.description: Manually set the Kubernetes platform type. Possible values are k8s (native Kubernetes) and eks (Amazon EKS). When set, this completely overrides automatic detection based on the service account token issuer; automatic detection is skipped entirely. Intended for testing or environments where token-based detection isn't available.

fields.name: tls.debug
fields.description: Debug level between 0 (no information) and 4 (all details).

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: When enabled, turns on certificate validation when connecting to the Kubernetes API server.

fields.name: tls.verify_hostname
fields.description: When enabled, turns on hostname validation for certificates.

fields.name: tls.vhost
fields.description: Set an optional TLS virtual host for the Kubernetes API server connection.

fields.name: use_journal
fields.description: When enabled, the filter reads logs in Journald format.

fields.name: use_kubelet
fields.description: Optional feature flag to get metadata information from Kubelet instead of calling Kube Server API to enhance the log. This could mitigate the Kube API heavy traffic issue for large cluster. If used when any Kubernetes Namespace Meta fields are enabled, Kubelet will be used to fetch pod data, but namespace meta will still be fetched using the kube_url settings.

fields.name: use_pod_association
fields.description: Deprecated alias for aws_use_pod_association. Kept for backward compatibility with AWS Observability users.

fields.name: use_tag_for_meta
fields.description: When enabled, Kubernetes metadata (for example, pod_name, container_name, and namespace_name) will be extracted from the tag itself. Connection to Kubernetes API Server won't get established and API calls for metadata won't be made. See Workflow of Tail and Kubernetes Filter and Custom tag For enhanced filtering to better understand metadata extraction from tags.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
